* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initiate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent’s character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Local Trouble (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Local Trouble (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spelled “initiate” as “initate” (typo kept as published). PC-E1 text: “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent's character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.”<ref name="cl-1210_63">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
